_about: Sources of the paper's appendix source tables that have no converted LeRobot-v3 data on the site yet (no sample archive, no example clip). One entry per embodiment and source with the counts the paper lists (datasets, episodes, frames, hours = frames / fps, camera views, fps); `note` is the bracketed letter of the appendix table ([A]-[D], text in `notes`), null for a source of the training mix whose remaining datasets are still unconverted. `entry` names the data/sources.json key when it differs from `source`. Hand-maintained; tools/build_site_data.py copies it into data/datasets.json as `pending` and checks every entry against data/sources.json.

notes.A: not in the frozen training mix
notes.B: held out: calibration not fully validated
notes.C: each hand tracked in its own frame
notes.D: dexterous-hand wrist-camera data; no dexterous action head yet

paper._about: Totals quoted by the header ('Full dataset') and the footer of the site. Since 2026-10-30 these are the totals of the commercially licensed data only: the converted datasets of data/datasets.json after tools/trim_noncommercial.py (sources with a commercial-use licence; RH20T counted by its RH20T-C episodes) plus the listed-but-unconverted entries below. The paper's own appendix tables still include the non-commercial sources (70 sources, 4,469 datasets, 2,450,988 episodes, 25,850.7 h over 24 embodiment groups) and differ on purpose. Recompute from `python3 tools/trim_noncommercial.py --dry-run` (totals + pending) when rows or entries change; tools/build_site_data.py copies these values to totals.paper and warns when the site's own sums differ.

entries.remark: 3 of 6 tasks (open lid, battery disassembly, LAN plug insertion); the other 3 are converted
